title: Wait for the salary
summary: The classic: the employee waits (releasing the mutex) until the balance is enough.
hints: Employee: `lock; while (balance < 1000) pthread_cond_wait(&enough, &m); balance -= 1000; unlock;` six times. Do NOT sleep while holding the mutex: the bank could never deposit.
Bank: twice, `sleep(1)` (outside the lock), then `lock; balance += 3000; pthread_cond_signal(&enough); unlock;`.
